# The Party: Character Sheets (level 1)

> Player-safe. These are the four brothers-and-friend as they stand on day one. House rules are in `rules-and-house-rules.md`.
> **Modifier key:** 8 = −1, 10–11 = +0, 12–13 = +1, 14–15 = +2, 16–17 = +3, 18–19 = +4, 20 = +5. Proficiency bonus +2 at levels 1–4.


## Ash (Asheron Fenwick), level 1
**Human Rogue 1 · Wayfarer background · age 20 · the youngest brother**
*Subclass at level 3: Thief-Swashbuckler (house rule; see the rules file).*

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13 (+1) | **18 (+4)** | 14 (+2) | 13 (+1) | 14 (+2) | **18 (+4)** |

- **Armor Class:** 15 (leather armor 11 + Dex 4)
- **Hit Points:** 10 (hit die d8; +7 per level after 1st, or roll d8+2)
- **Initiative:** +4 · **Speed:** 30 ft · **Size:** Medium
- **Proficiency bonus:** +2
- **Saving throws:** **Dex +6**, **Int +3** (proficient) · Str +1 · Con +2 · Wis +2 · Cha +4
- **Skills:** **Stealth +8** (expertise) · **Perception +6** (expertise) · Sleight of Hand +6 · Deception +6 · Acrobatics +6 · Persuasion +6 · Insight +4. Untrained: Athletics +1, Investigation +1, Intimidation +4, others at the score's modifier.
- **Passive Perception:** 16 · **Passive Insight:** 14
- **Tools:** Thieves' Tools +6 · Playing Cards +6 (proficient). He also owns dice and a shell-game set (cups and ball) without proficiency. The shell game uses Sleight of Hand.
- **Languages:** Common, Thieves' Cant, Dwarvish, Halfling

**Attacks**
| Weapon | To hit | Damage | Mastery / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Shortsword | +6 | 1d6+4 piercing | **Vex:** on a hit, advantage on your next attack against that creature before the end of your next turn. Light, finesse. |
| Dagger (off hand) | +6 | 1d4 piercing (no modifier on the extra off-hand attack) | **Nick:** the extra Light-weapon attack happens as part of the Attack action, not as a bonus action. |
| Dagger (thrown) | +6 | 1d4+4 piercing | Range 20/60 |
| Shortbow | +6 | 1d6+4 piercing | Range 80/320. No mastery. |

**Typical turn:** Attack with the shortsword, then the off-hand dagger as part of the same action (Nick). His **bonus action** stays free, for Cunning Action from level 2.

**Rogue features**
- **Sneak Attack (1d6):** once per turn, +1d6 to one hit with a finesse or ranged weapon if you have advantage, **or** if an ally of yours is within 5 feet of the target (and you don't have disadvantage).
- **Expertise:** Stealth, Perception. (Two more at level 6.)
- **Thieves' Cant:** the secret signs and slang of thieves.
- **Weapon Mastery:** Shortsword (Vex), Dagger (Nick).

**Feats**
- **Lucky** (Wayfarer): **2 Luck Points** per long rest (equal to proficiency bonus). Spend one for advantage on your own d20 test, decided after the roll, or to give disadvantage to an attack against you.
- **Magic Initiate (Wizard)** (human Versatile): spellcasting ability **Charisma**. **Spell save DC 12 · spell attack +6.**
  - Cantrips: **Message**, **Prestidigitation**
  - 1st level: **Find Familiar**, free once per long rest (still needs 10 gp of incense), or as a ritual

**Human traits:** Resourceful (Heroic Inspiration after every long rest) · Skillful (Persuasion) · Versatile (Magic Initiate)

**Familiar: Bartholomew ("Bart"), owl**
- AC 11 · HP 1 · Speed 5 ft, fly 60 ft · darkvision 120 ft · Perception +5, Stealth +5
- **Flyby:** no opportunity attacks when he flies out of reach
- Telepathic to Ash only, within 100 feet. Uses **Help** to give Ash advantage.
- Celestial spirit. Free shape-swap once a day out of combat (house rule); he picks the shape.
- Personality: snarky, mocks the brothers, lippy with Ash.

**Gear**
- **Armor and weapons:** leather armor · shortsword · 4 daggers · shortbow, quiver, 20 arrows
- **Tools:** thieves' tools
- **Burglar's pack:** backpack, ball bearings, bell, 10 candles, crowbar, hooded lantern, 7 flasks of oil, 5 days of rations, 50 ft of rope, tinderbox, waterskin
- **Clothes and bedding:** bedroll · traveler's clothes · fine clothes · 2 pouches
- **Games:** playing cards · dice · shell-game cups and ball
- **Bought:** manacles · grappling hook · caltrops (bag) · steel mirror · chalk · 10 pitons
- **Keepsake:** a dented pewter half-locket on a leather cord under his shirt. On the front is a worn crest: a river ford with antlers above it. Inside, behind cracked glass, is a curl of baby hair and a scratched "A." The hinge is broken off on one side. Gideon gave it to him when he was ten: "That was Mum's. That's your hair in it. The other half was lost in the fire." Ash has pawned everything he owns at least once. He's never pawned this, and he's never quite been able to say why.
- **Coin:** 10 gp

**Coming up (Rogue):** L2 Cunning Action (Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action) · L3 subclass + Steady Aim · L4 feat · L5 Cunning Strike, Uncanny Dodge · L6 Expertise ×2 · L7 Evasion, Reliable Talent · L8 feat · L9 Panache · L10 feat · L11 Improved Cunning Strike · L12 feat · L13 Use Magic Device · L14 Devious Strikes · L15 Slippery Mind · L16 feat · L17 Thief's Reflexes · L18 Elusive · L19 Epic Boon · L20 Stroke of Luck. Sneak Attack grows by 1d6 every odd level, to 10d6 at L19.

**Feat proposals (Ash's player confirms each one at level-up; these are suggestions only):**
| Level | Proposal | Why |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | **Ability Score Improvement:** Dex 18 → 20 | Every attack, AC, Stealth and initiative go up |
| 8 | **Alert** | You traded it away at level 1. Here it comes back: +3 initiative and Initiative Swap. |
| 10 | **Ability Score Improvement:** Cha 18 → 20 | Panache, Persuasion, Deception, spell DC |
| 12 | **Resilient (Wisdom)**, Wis 15 | Proficiency in Wisdom saves. Mind-affecting magic gets nastier at high levels. |
| 16 | **Tavern Brawler**, or **Tough** | The fight rings, or simply staying alive |
| 19 | **Boon of Combat Prowess** | Once per turn, a miss can become a hit, which nearly guarantees Sneak Attack |

## Gideon Fenwick, level 1
**Human Paladin 1 · Guard background · age 32 · the oldest brother**
*Oath at level 3: Oath of the Ancients. In the 2024 rules every paladin chooses an oath at level 3, so Gideon hasn't sworn yet.*

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **18 (+4)** | 12 (+1) | 15 (+2) | 13 (+1) | 16 (+3) | **16 (+3)** |
(Rolled 17/12/15/13/14/16. Guard background: +1 Str, +2 Wis.)

- **Armor Class:** 18 (chain mail 16 + shield 2)
- **Hit Points:** 14 (d10 + Con 2 + Tough 2; +10 per level after 1st)
- **Initiative:** +3 (Alert) · **Speed:** 30 ft
- **Saving throws:** **Wis +5**, **Cha +5** (proficient) · Str +4 · Dex +1 · Con +2 · Int +1
- **Skills:** Athletics +6 · Perception +5 · Intimidation +5 · Medicine +5 · Insight +5
- **Passive Perception:** 15
- **Tools:** Dice set (Guard gaming set)
- **Languages:** Common, Dwarvish, Elvish

**Attacks**
| Weapon | To hit | Damage | Mastery |
|---|---|---|---|
| Longsword | +6 | 1d8+4 slashing (1d10+4 two-handed) | **Sap:** on a hit, the target has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn |
| Javelin (×6) | +6 | 1d6+4 piercing, thrown 30/120 | **Slow:** on a hit, the target's speed drops by 10 ft until the start of your next turn |

**Paladin features:** Lay on Hands (pool of 5 hit points per long rest) · Spellcasting (Charisma, **DC 13**, attack +5, two 1st-level slots, 2 prepared spells: **Bless**, **Cure Wounds**) · Weapon Mastery
**Feats:** **Alert** (Guard background) · **Tough** (human Versatile)
**Human traits:** Resourceful · Skillful (Insight) · Versatile (Tough)

**Gear:** chain mail · shield · longsword · 6 javelins · holy symbol (an old bargeman's medal of the river's lady, worn on a cord) · priest's pack · watchman's lantern and cudgel from his job (no game effect) · **9 gp**, most of it already promised to the house tax

**Coming up:** L2 Fighting Style (**Protection**: when a creature attacks someone else within 5 feet of Gideon, his reaction gives it disadvantage) and Paladin's Smite (free Divine Smite once per long rest) · L3 Oath of the Ancients, Channel Divinity · L4 feat (**Str 18 → 20**) · L5 Extra Attack · L6 Aura of Protection · L7 Aura of Warding · L8 feat (**Cha 16 → 18**) · L9 Abjure Foes · L10 Aura of Courage · L11 Radiant Strikes · L12 feat (Cha → 20) · L14 Restoring Touch · L15 Undying Sentinel · L16 feat (Sentinel) · L18 Aura Expansion · L19 Epic Boon (Fortitude) · L20 Elder Champion

## Zeke (Ezekiel Fenwick), level 1
**Human Wizard 1 · Sage background · age 31 · the middle brother**
*Arcane Tradition at level 3: **Wardwright** (house rule: half Abjurer, half Evoker; see `rules-and-house-rules.md` §3A). He builds his shields like gadgets, and he blows things up when his family is in danger.*

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8 (−1) | 13 (+1) | **18 (+4)** | **18 (+4)** | 12 (+1) | 11 (+0) |
(Rolled 8/13/16/17/12/11. Sage background: +2 Con, +1 Int.)

- **Armor Class:** 11 (14 with Mage Armor, which he casts every morning)
- **Hit Points:** 10 (d6 + Con 4; +8 per level after 1st)
- **Initiative:** +1 · **Speed:** 30 ft
- **Saving throws:** **Int +6**, **Wis +3** (proficient) · Str −1 · Dex +1 · Con +4 · Cha +0
- **Skills:** Arcana +6 · History +6 · Investigation +6 · Nature +6 · Perception +3
- **Passive Perception:** 13
- **Tools:** Calligrapher's Supplies · Tinker's Tools · Jeweler's Tools · Glassblower's Tools
- **Languages:** Common, Gnomish, Draconic

**Attacks and cantrips**
| | To hit / save | Damage | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fire Bolt | +6 | 1d10 fire | 120 ft |
| Shocking Grasp | +6 | 1d8 lightning | Target can't make opportunity attacks. Good for escaping. |
| Dagger | +3 | 1d4+1 | He'd rather not |

**Wizard features:** Spellcasting (Int, **DC 14**, attack +6, two 1st-level slots, 4 prepared) · Ritual Adept (cast any ritual in his spellbook without preparing it) · Arcane Recovery (regain slots on a short rest, once per day)
- **Cantrips:** Fire Bolt, Mending, Mage Hand (class) · Shocking Grasp, Light (Magic Initiate)
- **Spellbook:** Shield, Thunderwave, Sleep, Magic Missile, Detect Magic, Identify
- **Prepared:** Shield, Thunderwave, Sleep, Magic Missile (Detect Magic and Identify as rituals)
- **Magic Initiate (Wizard):** **Mage Armor**, free once per long rest

**Feats:** **Magic Initiate (Wizard)** (Sage background) · **Crafter** (human Versatile: 20% off nonmagical gear, and he can craft simple items during a long rest)
**Human traits:** Resourceful · Skillful (Perception) · Versatile (Crafter)

**Gear:** spellbook (patched, half its margins full of gadget sketches) · quarterstaff arcane focus · 2 daggers · robe · scholar's pack · calligrapher's supplies · his attic tinkering tools · spectacles · **5 gp**

**Coming up:** L2 Scholar (expertise in **Arcana**) · L3 **Wardwright**: Wright's Savant (free: **Shatter**, **Arcane Lock**) and **the Harness** (Arcane Ward, 10 HP) · L4 feat (**Int 18 → 20**) · L5 Memorize Spell, 3rd-level spells (**Counterspell**, 2014 version; **Fireball**) · L6 **Sculpt Spells** · L8 feat (**War Caster**) · L10 **Projected Ward** and **the Wright's Pick** (Counterspell *or* Dispel Magic, always prepared; **Jeremy picks** at level 10) · L12 feat (**Resilient (Dex)** or **Alert**) · L14 **Overchannel** · L16 feat · L18 Spell Mastery (Shield, Misty Step) · L19 Epic Boon (Spell Recall) · L20 Signature Spells (Counterspell, Fireball)

## Moss, level 1
**Human Druid 1 · Hermit background · the herbalist halfway up Willow Lane**
*Druid Circle at level 3: Circle of the Moon.*

| STR | DEX | CON | INT | WIS | CHA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12 (+1) | 15 (+2) | 17 (+3) | 12 (+1) | **18 (+4)** | 12 (+1) |
(Rolled 12/15/16/12/16/12. Hermit background: +2 Wis, +1 Con.)

- **Armor Class:** 16 (hide armor 12 + Dex 2, + shield 2; druids don't wear metal)
- **Hit Points:** 13 (d8 + Con 3 + Tough 2; +10 per level after 1st)
- **Initiative:** +2 · **Speed:** 30 ft
- **Saving throws:** **Int +3**, **Wis +6** (proficient) · Str +1 · Dex +2 · Con +3 · Cha +1
- **Skills:** Medicine +6 · Animal Handling +6 · Survival +6 · Nature +3 · Religion +3 · Perception +4 (untrained) · Insight +4 (untrained)
- **Passive Perception:** 14
- **Tools:** Herbalism Kit +6
- **Languages:** Common, Druidic, Elvish, Dwarvish

**Attacks**
| Weapon | To hit | Damage | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Quarterstaff (Shillelagh) | +6 | 1d8+4 bludgeoning (or force) | The Shillelagh cantrip uses Wisdom |
| Sickle | +3 | 1d4+1 slashing | |

**Druid features:** Spellcasting (Wis, **DC 14**, attack +6, two 1st-level slots, 4 prepared) · Druidic · **Primal Order: Warden** (martial weapons and medium armor)
- **Cantrips:** Shillelagh, Guidance
- **Prepared:** Healing Word, Cure Wounds, Entangle, Thunderwave

**Feats:** **Healer** (Hermit background: as an action, spend one use of a healer's kit to let an ally within 5 ft spend a Hit Point Die and heal that roll + Moss's proficiency bonus; he rerolls 1s on any healing dice) · **Tough** (human Versatile)
**Human traits:** Resourceful · Skillful (Survival) · Versatile (Tough)

**Gear:** hide armor · wooden shield · quarterstaff (an old knotted thing he calls "the stick") · sickle · herbalism kit · healer's kit · explorer's pack · a satchel that always smells of mint and wet earth · **9 gp** (the Green Jar's till is Aggie's business)

**Coming up:** L2 **Wild Shape** (beast forms) and Wild Companion · L3 Circle of the Moon (Circle Forms: tougher beast shapes, AC 13 + Wis, temporary hit points equal to 3 × druid level, Moon spells) · L4 feat (**Resilient (Con)**, Con 18) · L5 Wild Resurgence · L6 Improved Circle Forms · L7 Elemental Fury · L8 feat (**War Caster**) · L10 Moonlight Step · L12 feat (Wis 18 → 20) · L14 Lunar Form · L15 Improved Elemental Fury · L16 feat · L18 Beast Spells · L19 Epic Boon · L20 Archdruid
